passenger_flow.rationale: Authority, clarity, and function-first. High contrast ensures readability during quick, on-the-go interactions. White base with stark black elements and Signal Yellow accents.

driver_flow.rationale: High-visibility command center look. Reduces eye strain at night. Deep Obsidian base, Pure White text, Volt Green kinetic triggers for ride acceptance.

headings.rule: Never use Inter for headings. Use high impact sans-serif.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing for Passenger (p-6, p-8) for approachability. Tactical dense spacing (p-4) for Driver.
spacing_and_layout.buttons: h-14 w-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-lg rounded-xl

surfaces_and_micro_themes.map_overlays: Glassmorphism: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/40 (Passenger) | bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10 (Driver)
surfaces_and_micro_themes.driver_action_card: Neumorphism with 1px solid stroke (border-white/10) for tactical focus.

role_selection.title: Wybierz swoją rolę
role_selection.layout: Full screen background image with gradient overlay (bg-black/50). Floating crystal glass cards for role selection.

passenger_home.map_elements: Custom markers for available drivers. Floating action button (FAB) for centering map.

images.description: Modern city street at sunset. Use as full-screen background for Role Selection and Login screens with bg-black/50 overlay.
Person using a smartphone app. Use for Passenger Profile or onboarding screens.
Close up of a hand on steering wheel. Use for Driver Profile or onboarding screens.

accessibility_and_interactions.test_ids: MUST include data-testid on all buttons, inputs, map markers, and bottom sheet toggles (e.g., data-testid='role-passenger-btn').
accessibility_and_interactions.contrast: Ensure pure black/white contrast on Passenger mode and Volt Green/Black on Driver mode for readability.
accessibility_and_interactions.animations: Use smooth bottom sheet transitions. Map should animate to user location.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native SDK 54 app. Do not use pure HTML components, use React Native components (`View`, `Text`, `TouchableOpacity`, `Modal`) styled with NativeWind (Tailwind).
Implement Map via `react-native-maps` pointing to OpenStreetMap. Use standard mapview but overlay our UI on top.
Use two distinct color themes: Light (Passenger) and Dark (Driver).
Ensure all text is strictly in Polish.
Never use placeholder images. Use the URLs provided in the `images` array.
Ensure generous padding is applied to interactive elements for touch target compliance (min 44x44 points).
